app.name: Diwali Express Pickup
app.tagline: Order from licensed Diwali shops near you. Collect at the shop's Express Pickup counter and pay there.

safety.notice: Green crackers only. Burst only between 8 pm and 10 pm on Diwali, as per Supreme Court orders. Keep children supervised.

about.eyebrow: For customers, merchants, police and fire officers
about.title: How Diwali Express Pickup works
about.subtitle: Customers order from licensed Diwali shops and collect at each shop's Express Pickup counter. Packing, billing and payment for crackers happen at the licensed shop.

payShop.title: You pay the shop
payShop.body: Crackers are paid for at the shop's counter, straight to the shop. The platform collects only a ₹30 fee, refunded if the shop doesn't confirm within 3 days.

pickupOnly.title: Pickup only
pickupOnly.body: The platform never stores, carries or sends crackers anywhere. Orders are packed and handed over at the licensed shop.

noCommission.title: No commission
noCommission.body: Shops keep their full sale. The platform takes no cut of what you buy.

licensed.title: Licensed shops only
licensed.body: Each shop's licence is checked before it is listed. Licence numbers and validity are shown on every shop page, and shops disappear when a licence expires.

green.title: Green crackers only
green.body: Every item carries a CSIR-NEERI green-cracker reference. Joined (series/lari) and barium crackers cannot be listed.

privacy.title: Phone number only
privacy.body: We keep only a phone number, with consent. Shops see its last four digits. It is deleted 90 days after the season, or any time on request.

order.title: Order
order.body: Pick crackers from a licensed shop and pay the ₹30 platform fee.

confirm.title: Shop confirms
confirm.body: The shop confirms within 3 days, or your fee is refunded.

pack.title: Packed
pack.body: A packer scans every item. If something is out of stock, you choose what happens.

pickup.title: Express Pickup
pickup.body: Show your QR at the counter, collect your pack and pay the shop.

about.legal: Online ordering is switched on only after the platform's legal review. The sale, billing and payment for crackers happen at the licensed shop counter, as Supreme Court orders and the Explosives Rules require licensed retail.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your account type ({{role}}) cannot open {{area}}. Ask the Diwali Express Pickup team if you need access.

terms.accept: I have read and accept the

customer: You pay a ₹30 platform fee for each order; it is refunded if the shop does not confirm in 3 days.
You pay the shop for your items at its counter; the platform never takes that money.
Your phone number is used only to sign in and to show your orders.
merchant: The season subscription is ₹1,999 + GST, paid to Diwali Express. It is not tied to any order.
Never pay an agent in cash. Every payment is made on the platform's page.
Customers pay you directly at your counter. The platform takes no commission.
Platform credit customers use on your bills is paid to you weekly or on request.
agent: You set up shops only with the owner's consent (their code or their tap on the link).
You are paid ₹1,000 once for each shop that is paid and goes live. Nothing for shops the owner sets up alone.
You never collect money from merchants, never see customer data, and never edit a shop after approval.
Each ₹1,000 is sent to your own UPI ID. PAN is needed from ₹18,000 earned in a year; 2% TDS applies above ₹20,000.
A refunded subscription or a failed licence within 30 days reverses the ₹1,000. One device signed in at a time.
